content.introduction: Interest rates remain steady; Federal Reserve forecasts one rate cut in 2026. The decision was not unanimous, with four officials dissenting. The Fed interest rate is currently 3.75%.
body: [News • 5 days ago A third straight robust jobs report just laid the groundwork for a potential Fed rate hike later this year](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/article/strong-may-jobs-report-will-keep-fed-focused-on-inflation-with-possibility-of-hikes-later-this-year-134835143.html?.tsrc=fin-notif). [Stocks fell on Wednesday](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/live/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-losses-accelerate-after-fed-decision-as-powell-touts-inflation-worries-185152647.html?pl2=everyday-hero_lead)and [Thursday](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/live/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-recover-from-steep-losses-as-oils-surge-eases-200040220.html) after Fed Chair Jerome Powell underscored the uncertainty surrounding the oil shock during his press conference and said the US had not made as much progress on inflation as it had hoped. > In comments to reporters on Wednesday, Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell acknowledged that the oil crisis resulting from the Iran war [could drive up inflation](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/federal-reserve-holds-interest-rates-steady-keeps-1-cut-in-play-this-year-as-uncertainty-mounts-130010108.html?pl2=everyday-hero_lead). > Even as he said “there will be some effects on inflation going forward," the Fed chair stuck to the same line when asked to make predictions about just how large the effects of the war in the Middle East could be: "The implications of [developments in the Middle East](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/live/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-futures-fall-oil-surges-after-iran-inflation-worries-sink-stocks-225027246.html?pl2=everyday-hero_lead) on the US economy are uncertain.".
